title: Turkish Yeasty, Springy Flaxseed Kazandibi
description: A charred, springy, festive Turkish dish featuring flaxseed in a pandan-leaf vessel.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and yeast.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Add the flaxseeds and mix until well combined.
Pour the batter into the pandan-leaf vessel and cover with another leaf.
Place the vessel in a steamer basket and steam for 30 minutes.
Remove the vessel from the steamer and place it in the preheated oven.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the edges are charred.
Remove the vessel from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Invert the vessel onto a serving plate and serve warm.
Serve with a drizzle of honey, if desired.
